summary_en: Meisei Industrial will cancel 4,000,000 common shares, representing 7.3% of issued shares before cancellation, effective November 30, 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: On October 30, 2026, Meisei Industrial's board of directors resolved to cancel 4,000,000 treasury shares of common stock under the provisions of Article 178 of the Companies Act. The cancellation will become effective on November 30, 2026. The shares to be cancelled represent 7.3% of the company's issued shares prior to cancellation. Following the cancellation, the company's total issued shares will be 51,117,218 shares.
